channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 18th Annual Baytowne Wharf Beer Festival (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Fri 10/16 · 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM (Backyard Bash) · Sat 10/17 · 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM (Grand Tasting) | Baytowne Wharf Events Plaza | from $45. The 18th annual festival runs a Friday tailgate-style Backyard Bash followed by Saturday's grand craft-beer tasting, both with live music and food. The festival's own pages describe the beer lineup as either over 100 or 150+ craft beers depending on which page you read, and admission is 21+ for the tasting though the Village around it stays open to everyone.

item.title: 2026 Walton County Fair (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Monday 10/12 to Saturday 10/17 · gates 5:00 PM (Saturday noon) · final tickets sold at 9:00 PM | Walton County Fairgrounds | from $5. The Walton County Fair runs Monday, October 12 through Saturday, October 17 at the fairgrounds in DeFuniak Springs, with its tagline Rooted in Tradition, Built for the Future. The week has a carnival midway with new rides, the famous pig show and outdoor concerts on Friday and Saturday nights, plus vendor and food booths and food trucks. Gates open at 5:00 PM, or noon on Saturday, and the final tickets are sold at 9:00 PM each night.

item.title: Blithe Spirit: Theatre 98 (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Weekends 10/16-11/1/2026 · eves + matinees | Theatre 98, Fairhope | from $20. Noël Coward's classic ghost-comedy plays at Fairhope's intimate community playhouse, a witty, dressed-up date in Fairhope.

item.title: CCB Lobster Fest, Round 2 (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Fri 10/16 to Sun 10/18 (moved from 10/9 to 10/11 for the weather) | Coastal County Brewing Company | No published price. Coastal County Brewing Company brings Lobster Fest back for a second round from October 9 to 11. The brewery lists Friday starting at 5:00 PM and Saturday and Sunday from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. The event is at the brewery on E Olive Rd in Pensacola.

item.title: FUDS Volleyball Registration Party at Fudpucker's (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Friday 10/16 · 9:00 PM to 2:00 AM | Fudpucker's Beachside Bar & Grill | Free. Fudpucker's kicks off its fall FUDS volleyball season on Friday, October 16 with a player registration party. Music by Shenanigans and DJ Boom starts at 9:00 PM on the big deck, and DJ Rhythm X plays in the Down Under Bar. The party is open to the public with no cover and drink specials all night.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: Karaoke & DJ Nights: FUBAR Pizza Bar (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Nightly · 9 PM-1 AM | FUBAR Pizza Bar | Free. Late-night karaoke runs five nights a week (Sun, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat) plus a DJ on Monday and Thursday, 9 PM to 1 AM every night, with pizza till close. It is in Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Karaoke Block: The Block (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Wed-Sat · from 6 PM (Thu 8 PM) | The Block | Free. The Sports & Karaoke room at The Block runs Wednesday through Saturday, opening at 6 (8 on Thursday) and going late. It is downtown Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Live Music: Manci's Antique Club (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Thu 6:30 PM · Fri-Sat 7:30 PM · Sun 6:00 PM | Manci's Antique Club | Free. This Daphne institution has walls of Jim Beam decanters and live local bands Thursday through Sunday. It is a grown-up night out.

item.title: Live Music: Paradise Bar & Grill (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Tue/Fri/Sat 5:30 PM · Sun 2:30 PM | Paradise Bar & Grill | Free. Beachside live music plays most nights on Pensacola Beach, with rotating local acts starting at 5:30 (Sundays 2:30). Wine Down Wednesday runs $3 house and $6 premium wines all day.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM · opening reception Thursday 10/8 · 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free, and the opening reception on October 8 runs from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Sunday 9/27 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Yoga: Friday and Wednesday beach classes (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Fridays 9 AM and Wednesdays 6 PM | Pensacola Beach Yoga, beside the Gulf Pier | from $10. Pensacola Beach Yoga runs drop-in yoga on the sand beside the Gulf Pier at 41 Fort Pickens Road in Pensacola Beach. Classes are Fridays at 9 AM and Wednesdays at 6 PM, and they cost $10 with no registration. Bring a mat or towel.

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Fridays 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM · Saturdays 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM · Sundays 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM through 11/1 (closed the weekend of 10/9 for the weather) | Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction | from $25. Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction runs an indoor haunted house at 811 St Francis St in downtown Mobile on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights through Sunday, November 1. Guests walk through dark mazes with live scare actors, and optional Blackout and Chamber mini escape games cost extra. The attraction warns it may be too intense for younger children, and every child must be accompanied by an adult.

item.title: The 39 Steps: Hitchcock Farce (ECTC) (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Oct 15-25 · Thu-Sat 7 PM · Sun 2 PM · Wed 1 PM · Thu 10/22 also 1 PM | Emerald Coast Theatre Company | No published price. Four actors play 150 roles in a full-tilt Hitchcock spoof that is clean, fast, and laugh-out-loud. It is the safe-bet theatre date of the fall.

item.title: The Late Night Comedy Show at Crescent Theater (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Friday 10/16 · 9:00 PM · doors 8:30 PM | Crescent Theater | from $8.76. The Crescent Theater runs a late night comedy bill on its Dauphin Street stage. The page lists no performers, so the lineup is a surprise until the night. Ticket prices run from $8.76 to $39.01 and the show is for ages 18 and up.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Weekend Live Music: Sandshaker Lounge (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Every weekend · evenings | Sandshaker Lounge | Free. The Shaker, birthplace of the Bushwacker, has live music every weekend and never a cover. It is a classic Pensacola Beach dive, about 25 minutes from the bridge.

item.title: Alabama Society for Healthcare Social Work Annual Conference (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Wednesday 10/14 · 7:30 AM to 12:00 PM | SpringHill Suites Orange Beach at The Wharf | No published price. SpringHill Suites Orange Beach at The Wharf hosts the Alabama Society for Healthcare Social Work Annual Conference starting Wednesday, October 14. Health care social workers, educators, administrators, students, and interdisciplinary professionals gather for three days of professional development, continuing education, and networking.

item.title: 2026 Bud Light Charity Challenge (tennis) (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Friday 10/16 to Saturday 10/17 · 8:00 AM | Roger Scott Tennis Complex | $15 for two. The 2026 Bud Light Charity Challenge is a two-day adult doubles tennis tournament at the Roger Scott Tennis Complex in Pensacola. It benefits The Arc Gateway and Pensacola Sports. Family and friends can attend with a guest pass picked up at check-in.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (FRI 10/16)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (FRI 10/16)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (FRI 10/16)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (FRI 10/16)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Emerald Coast Fall Classic Beach Volleyball (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Wednesday 10/14 to Sunday 10/18 · 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM daily | The Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island | No published price. Beach volleyball teams play doubles and the Fudpucker four-player tournament on the sand at the Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island. Play runs 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM each day. The Men and Women pool play is Saturday, and playoffs and finals are Sunday, with the Women's Open final around 3:00 PM and a costume contest at 3:45 PM. The schedule is tentative, so check the tournament page before driving.

item.title: Fall Into Family History at Santa Rosa County Libraries (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 Pace · Wednesday 10/14 Jay · Wednesday 10/21 Gulf Breeze · Wednesday 10/28 Navarre · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Santa Rosa County libraries: Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze and Navarre | No published price. The library system's lead reference specialist visits one branch each Wednesday in October to help people start or extend a family tree. Visitors can bring a specific research question or simply stop by to learn how to get started with the library's genealogy resources. The help runs during regular library hours, so no appointment time is listed.

item.title: Ping Pong Meet-Up (FRI 10/16)
item.description: 9:30 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This ping pong meetup at the Niceville Senior Center is open to beginners and experienced players alike, and the city says no experience is required to join in. It runs Wednesday mid morning and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Thursday 9/17 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Mexican Train Dominoes (FRI 10/16)
item.description: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Mexican Train Dominoes at the Niceville Senior Center is pitched as easy to learn, welcoming first-time players alongside the regulars. It runs Wednesday late morning into early afternoon and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: Story Time: Bats and ghosts at the Valparaiso Library (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Monday 10/12, Wednesday 10/14 and Friday 10/16 · 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM | Valparaiso Library | No published price. Valparaiso Library reads stories about bats and ghosts during its regular Monday, Wednesday and Friday morning story times, and the stories are not scary. Monday is for ages 0 to 5, Wednesday welcomes all ages and Friday is for ages 0 to 3. Registration is required for each session.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (FRI 10/16)
item.description: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Destin Community Center | from $2. Destin Community Center opens its tables for open table tennis play three days a week, Monday, Wednesday and Friday from 10 AM to 1 PM. Paddles and balls are provided, so nobody needs to bring their own equipment. Active Destin seniors play free, and non-residents pay $2.

item.title: DiscipleStory (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Sundays 9/13 – 10/18 (of an 8-week class) · 11:00 AM (end time not published) | Crosspoint Niceville Campus, Room 912 | No published price. An eight-week Sunday morning class at Crosspoint's Niceville campus walks participants through identifying their own story, passions, abilities and role in the church's mission. The class starts September 13 at 11 AM; the campus newsletter does not publish an end time.

item.title: Midday Melodies: Downtown Foley (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 · 11:00 AM | Heritage Park | No published price. Foley Main Street schedules a lunchtime concert at Heritage Park on Wednesdays in October, starting October 7 at 11:00 AM. The 2026 lineup is the Wiley Pete Duo on October 7, Dan Lee on October 14, This Side of 49 on October 21, and Tennessee Tim and Doug Drake on October 28. The 2025 series invited guests to bring a picnic blanket or lawn chair and pick up lunch from a nearby downtown restaurant.

item.title: Mobile Greek Fest 2026 (FRI 10/16)
item.description: Thu 10/15 – Sat 10/17 · 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM | Annunciation Greek Orthodox Church | Free. Mobile's Greek community has run a festival downtown since Greek Night began in 1962, and the modern three-day version fills the church grounds with food, sanctuary tours, live Greek music and youth dance performances. The festival is cashless this year, so bring a card rather than cash.
